data.label: Training pages: Black Jack ni Yoroshiku (Give My Regards to Black Jack)
Training pages: Comix v0.1 (Digital Comic Museum)
Training pages: Synthetic lettering on Pepper&Carrot art (round 3)
Test labels
data.value: Not checked by a person. Pepper&Carrot and Black Jack test pages: labelled automatically, reviewed by Claude. Old American: 42 Comix pages whose boxes Claude corrected by hand. Manga: an outside dataset's own labels (manga-text-detection, Indonesian scanlations). Manhua and webtoon: held-out pages of outside datasets, with their own labels. Each finder is scored on the boxes its page shows. Found = a box covers at least half of the bubble; text found = covers at least half of the words in it; extra boxes = boxes that find nothing (repeats, or boxes on art), counted before the page reads them: the page then also drops boxes it cannot read and repeats that read the same words, so it shows fewer.
